review_type: one complete frozen pipeline; independent semantic source assessment
overall_reason: No source-backed material error, material omission or unsupported consequential decision remains in the self-contained final within the original bounded proposal scope. Five disclosed minor/bounded limitations and independent mechanics unknowns remain. This is source qualification, not deployment approval, native lifecycle certification or savings evidence.

axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: The original glaze-water scenario, confounded extra bucket, particle/dissolved distinction, four compared options, flow/material/labor/residual issues, prior-implementation inquiry and later pilot are preserved. No potable/discharge/compliance/harmlessness inference, invented chemistry/throughput, chemical dosing, wet work or disposal route is supplied. Conditional clay-only filtration breadth is bounded in L4, not treated as a glaze deployment.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axes.assessment: All twelve carried source identities were independently retrieved and consequential claims checked in governing context. Historical draft status, U.S. jurisdiction, operational 0.45 µm elemental fraction, gravimetric TSS, 85 L versus 70 L, model/year specifications, one-sink sudden-20-L inflow warning, Cink glaze exclusion and no-sewer rule are correctly bounded. Prices/weights and the existence of a noise account are supported as attributed observations. L1/L3 remain minor locator/maintenance wording.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Useful discoveries include working versus internal separator volume, recurrent pulse overflow across manual editions, a product-use exclusion that changes applicability, weekly refresh and filter labor, analytically different fractions, old pottery recycling/underflow implementations and one bounded noise report. Alternatives compete on flow, maintenance and residuals rather than device preference. History/release differences are investigated without inventing fixes. L4/L5 bound what was established.

axes.name: Wrong criticisms/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: C1 is a real stale policy-string defect (S01–S10 policy versus S01–S12 records), appropriately accepted in final metadata without ID rebinding. No false substantive correction/rejection was found. The critic no-material-issue opinion was independently assessed, not used as proof. All 55 exact sentence/bullet records, including authoring/procedural context, are covered in the independent clause audit; they are not 55 invented product obligations.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery/draft/critique/final
axes.assessment: The final is self-contained: mechanism/limits, options, transfer checklist, gated pilot, chemistry/local review, workload matching, no winner and proposed/executed distinctions remain. Stable URLs/IDs retain binding. Later discovery of S11/S12 is carried in draft/final without claiming pre-release discovery contained those additions. C1 is corrected; the final strengthens the historical 14-plant accounting and clarifies inherited price audit status. The maintenance wording ambiguity and TSS/settleable compression are recorded in L2/L3.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: The proposed study has inventory/route gates, event/workload baseline, recorded volumes for loads, matched prespecified conditions, representative paired samples, lab-selected analytes/fractions/QC, labor/failure/residual logs and concrete leak/overflow/cross-contamination/endpoint escalation. This can distinguish quieter workload from treatment changes and prevents clarity-only acceptance. E13 confirms grab/composite representativeness has conditions; L2 bounds choice of particle metric. Only desktop source checks are evidenced/claimed as executed; no field, lab, wet, performance, residence-time, permission or safety validation is established.

limitations.finding: S05 inherited PDF pp. 14–18 locator does not accurately cover the full Appendix A-3 SOP/QC; web page indices place SOP on P15–P19 zero-based, or one-based pages 16–20 (cover on one-based 15).
limitations.why_not_material: Exact document, appendix, method and revision remain identifiable; no QC result or required workshop protocol is falsely asserted.

limitations.finding: Final line 69 says TSS or settleable solids. These are different observables; settleable solids alone cannot establish capture of all escaping nonsettling fines.
limitations.why_not_material: The final does not call them equivalent or report removal. It requires a current matrix-appropriate lab-selected method, identifies nonsettling fine particles, includes TSS explicitly and postpones endpoints before any pilot. This bounded proposal remains useful, rather than presenting a completed unsuitable oracle.

limitations.severity: minor maintenance wording / corrected lineage ambiguity
limitations.finding: Discovery/draft and inherited S10 notes loosely attach the three-month interval to string-filter cleaning/replacement. Manual specifies housing cleaning at least every three months and periodic/flow-driven cartridge replacement. Final narrows this to cleaning but does not precisely name the housing.
limitations.why_not_material: No system is being operated, sized or purchased, and the final does not impose a three-month cartridge replacement schedule. The labor/clogging and conditional-use reasoning remains supported.

limitations.finding: The filtration example and proposed filter arm are confined to reliably segregated clay-only water; no glaze-compatible filter configuration has been established. A one-product use ban is not a class-wide filtration ban.
limitations.why_not_material: The brief permits source segregation, unresolved external choices and provisional alternatives. The final discloses Cink rejection for the original glaze stream, still explains filtration capture/fouling/residuals, and retains settling plus glaze/unknown containment inquiry. It does not assert all particulate filtration fails or recommend running Cink on glaze. This limitation should not be mistaken for a fully selected glaze filtration design.

limitations.finding: Historical contractor examples and manufacturer manuals do not supply a current independent small-workshop efficacy record, complete service/recall history or verified noise measurement.
limitations.why_not_material: The final states these limits, identifies transfer requirements and does not convert missing evidence into success or absence-of-defect conclusions.

exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: The final explicitly calls this case synthetic.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Spend the 60-minute research window developing a research proposal for improving the handling of fine particles in this rinse stream.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Complete research proposal delivered within the recorded envelope; early finishing is allowed by assignments. The prose does not claim 60 minutes of experiments or actual inference/billing duration.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: We need a mechanism-based comparison of feasible approaches, a way to investigate previous implementations and their operating limitations, and a pilot design we can discuss with a qualified local partner.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Mechanism table, earlier examples and transfer checklist, and three-gate pilot all supply the requested content rather than only disclaimers.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Explain uncertainty and potential failure, not just a favored device.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Fine/nonsettling particles, inflow pulses, resuspension, cross-contamination, clogging, leaks, labor and residual uncertainties are explicit; no winner.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Do not build or operate a treatment system.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Source review only is declared; no build/operation result appears. Complete action-history attestation is unavailable.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Distinguish removal of suspended particles from management of dissolved constituents; clear-looking water is not a sufficient success criterion.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Suspended transfer and dissolved management are distinct; operational dissolved fraction is not full speciation. Neither clarity nor turbidity is sufficient.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Compare improved settling or flow management with a filtration approach and a useful non-treatment alternative such as source segregation or off-site handling.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Settling, filtration mechanism/conditional Cink comparator, segregation and containment are compared. The Cink exclusion is correct. The final gives no glaze-compatible filtration model, and its only clay-only wording limits the prospective filter arm; this is a disclosed conditional/rejected comparator, not evidence that all filtration is forbidden for glaze.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Address intermittent flow, variable glaze residues, cleaning labor, and the fate of collected solids in both the mechanism discussion and feasibility comparison.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Pulses and variable glaze material affect separation and segregation; the mechanism/feasibility table expressly includes recurring cleaning labor and unknown sludge/media/refresh-water fate.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Identify what an earlier implementation would need to report before its results could transfer to this small workshop.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Nine-part checklist covers source/feed, particle/phase characterization, flow/design, samples/QC, material variability, operations/downtime, residual destination, permission and scale/history.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Propose sampling, a baseline comparison, and a stopping or escalation condition; clearly separate validation proposed for a later pilot from anything actually checked during the research hour.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Baseline, workload/volume matching, event-aware paired samples, operational logs and stops are substantive. All are later proposed work. TSS versus settleable-solids wording is imprecise; qualified lab selection and non-visual endpoints remain explicit.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Do not infer potable water, safe discharge, regulatory compliance, or harmless solids from particle removal.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: No potability, discharge, compliance or harmless-solids inference is made from particle capture.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Do not prescribe chemical dosing, conduct wet experiments, discharge water, or give a final disposal route without the missing characterization and local review.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: No chemical treatment, wet experiment, discharge or final disposal route is prescribed or claimed executed. Historical flocculation and vendor residue guidance are explicitly non-transferable.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Do not replace unknown composition or throughput with convenient invented data.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Product dimensions/volumes are attributed manufacturer values, not workshop throughput. No site concentrations, particle sizes, flows, sample counts or action thresholds are invented.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: We do not yet know particle sizes, dissolved constituents, bucket geometry, daily volumes, disposal practices, space, or allowable labor.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Every listed unknown remains an owner/qualified-partner question.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: The supervisor has not decided whether preventing discharge entirely is acceptable.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: No-discharge acceptance remains an explicit supervisor decision; containment is a useful conditional arm.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Treat these as proposal questions, not hidden known values.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: The final assigns unknowns to a staged inquiry and does not fill them with hidden values.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Which characterization and operational comparisons would make a small-workshop particle-management pilot useful without confusing visual clarity with environmental suitability?
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: The proposal asks this governing question through characterization, matched comparisons and non-visual endpoints.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: The relevant endpoints, hazardous constituents if any, partner laboratory access, sampling burden, and acceptability of complete containment remain unresolved.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Endpoints, hazardous constituents if any, lab access, sampling burden and containment acceptability remain unresolved and assigned to the owner/partner.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: The proposal should support a staged go/no-go decision and a useful interim operating inquiry even if a treatment pilot is premature.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Gates permit chronology/flow/material inquiry before treatment. Contained handling is conditional on owner/partner acceptance, not a manufactured approval.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Research longer residence time and staged settling, flow buffering, replaceable or cleanable filtration, and separating concentrated rinses at the source.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Longer quiet periods, staged/baffled settling, buffering, bag/string filter maintenance and source segregation are researched. Filtration example is material-restricted, not a selected glaze-water device.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Include containment with approved collection as a useful alternative if treatment evidence or operation is inadequate.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Contained collection/off-site inquiry remains an alternative when performance/operation is inadequate, with actual acceptance unresolved.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Compare maintenance burden and solids handling along with removal claims.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Maintenance, staff time, collected solids/media and refresh water are coequal feasibility endpoints rather than ignored externalities.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Combinations may be reasonable, but are not presumed better.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Combinations remain possible after characterization; none is presumed better.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: Examine particle suspension, residence time, resuspension, filter capture and fouling, and the distinction between suspended and dissolved material.
exact_plan_clause_audit.assessment: Mechanisms and operating failure conditions cover suspension/slow settling, residence and disturbance, resuspension, capture/fouling, and dissolved material.

exact_plan_clause_audit.exact_clause: The proposal should say which properties and comparisons would distinguish these stories without implying a measured treatment efficiency.

useful_discoveries.discovery: TA 85 internal capacity is 85 L but fill is 70 L; a sudden 20 L sink release can overflow an already filled unit.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Compare actual pulse/usable-volume/cleanout conditions, not nominal volume alone.

useful_discoveries.discovery: Cink 2 explicitly excludes glazes and chemicals and is independent of sewer/septic.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Reject it for mixed glaze water; any clay-only comparator requires reliable segregation and does not validate glaze treatment.

useful_discoveries.discovery: Manufacturer maintenance includes water refresh, settling time, bag/bucket cleaning and clogging-related cartridge work.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Cleaning labor and refresh-water/solids handling are consequential feasibility outcomes.

useful_discoveries.discovery: Method 200.8 dissolved fraction is operationally 0.45 µm filtered; total-recoverable is a different preparation, not complete speciation.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Inventory-led chemistry and the qualified lab remain necessary separately from visible particle outcomes.

useful_discoveries.discovery: 1975 pottery survey has small-pottery settling/recycle and a more complex underflow-filtration example, but draft/scale/incomplete-metal limits.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Investigate implementation data/maintenance/fate before transfer; neither is a supplied success result.

useful_discoveries.discovery: Official TA 85 manual editions differ in specifications but repeat the flow warning; Cink page has updates and one noise account without a dated fix record.
useful_discoveries.consequence: Ask about exact equipment edition/operating history, without inventing physical changes or general defects.
